title: Use Trig Identity
text: For origin symmetry, replace theta with $$\theta+\pi$$ and simplify $$sin\left(2\left(\theta+\pi\right)\right)$$.

title: Check for Valid Output
text: Because $$sin\left(2\theta+2\pi\right)=sin\left(2\theta\right)$$, the equation is unchanged wherever the square root is real.
